no_rule_findings.finding: M.G.L. c. 40P § 4 bars any Massachusetts city or town from enacting, maintaining or enforcing rent control of any kind. The only exception is a narrow voluntary, compensated scheme limited to owners of 10 or more units with fair market rent of $400 or less, and it cannot regulate evictions. There is therefore no state or local rent increase cap.
